name: Phong Shading with Gradient Calculation
aliases: Phong Lighting Model for Volume Rendering
definition: A raycasting technique that applies Phong lighting with on-the-fly gradient calculation using central differences and early ray termination. It includes a transfer function.
summary: Phong Shading with Gradient Calculation is a local illumination technique that approximates surface normals via voxel data gradients to enable specular highlights in direct volume rendering without surface extraction.
